user.title: Welcome
user.description: Give this climate control a unique name.

expert_hardware.title: 1/6 · Devices & Sensors
expert_hardware.description: Configure the physical hardware in this room: thermostats, temperature sensors, window contacts and outside temperature source.

data_description.trvs: At least one TRV is required.
data_description.temp_sensor: External sensor overrides the TRV's built‑in reading for better accuracy.

data_description.window_sensors: Climate control pauses automatically when a sensor reports 'open'.
data_description.window_reaction_open: Wait this long before lowering the temperature.
data_description.window_reaction_close: Wait this long before restoring the temperature.
data_description.window_open_temp: Temperature used while a window or door is open (0.0 = OFF).

data_description.outside_temp_sensor: Temperature sensor used for the season mode threshold. Use a sensor entity for numeric readings.
data_description.outside_temp_threshold: Climate control is disabled when outside temperature exceeds (heating) or drops below (cooling) this value.
data_description.outside_temp_hysteresis: Prevents rapid switching near the threshold. Example with a threshold of 17 °C and hysteresis of 1 °C: turns off at 18 °C (heating) or 16 °C (cooling), turns back on at 16 °C (heating) or 18 °C (cooling).
data_description.outside_temp_fallback: If the outside sensor fails, assume climate control is needed.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional weather entity for Sunshine Offset. When sunny, the target temperature is reduced by the Sunshine Offset value. Allows using a separate temperature sensor for season mode and this entity for solar gain detection.

expert_climate.title: 2/6 · Climate & Schedule
expert_climate.description: Set target temperatures, choose your scheduling method, and configure thermostat calibration.

data_description.temp_comfort_static: Active temperature when someone is home.
data_description.hvac_mode_comfort: Which HVAC mode to set on the TRV during Comfort.
data_description.hvac_mode_eco: Which HVAC mode to set on the TRV during Eco.
data_description.hysteresis: Tolerance band used when 'Switch TRV off above room temperature' is enabled. The TRV switches off when room temperature exceeds target + hysteresis, and back on when it drops below target − hysteresis.

data_description.scheduling_mode: Choose 'Helper' for schedule entities or 'Calendar' for calendar‑based control.

data_description.adjustments: JSON array of time‑based or entity‑based temperature adjustments.

data_description.calibration_mode: 'Native' adjusts the TRV's internal offset; 'Generic' adjusts the target temperature.
data_description.generic_calibration_limit: Maximum allowed offset for generic calibration to prevent overheating on sensor failure.
data_description.calibration_delta: Minimum temperature difference before a calibration update is sent.
data_description.calibration_keyword: Only calibrate entities whose name contains this keyword.
data_description.calibration_timeout: How often to recalculate the calibration offset.

expert_climate_calendar.title: 3/6 · Calendar Settings
expert_climate_calendar.description: Fine‑tune how calendar events control this room's climate.

data_description.calendar: Select one or more calendar entities to watch for events.
data_description.calendar_event: Comma‑separated keywords. Only events matching these will trigger the climate control.
data_description.calendar_room: Optional: only respond to events at this location.
data_description.calendar_scan_interval: How often to check the calendar for new events.
data_description.holiday_calendar: Optional: a calendar.holiday_* entity from the HA Holiday integration. If a holiday is detected today, the heating schedule for the selected day is used instead.
data_description.holiday_use_day: Which weekday schedule to use on public holidays.
data_description.vacation_home_use_day: Overrides Holiday Use Day while the “Vacation at home” switch is active. Falls back to Holiday Use Day if left empty.

expert_presence.title: 4/6 · Presence & People
expert_presence.description: Configure who lives here, how guests are handled, and how the system detects occupancy.

data_description.persons: Persons whose home/away status affects climate control.
data_description.guest_mode: When any of these is ON, the system behaves as if someone is home.
data_description.people_entering_duration: Grace period before 'arriving home' triggers Comfort.
data_description.people_leaving_duration: Grace period before 'leaving home' triggers Eco.
data_description.persons_force_comfort: If ON, climate control will stay on Comfort as long as someone is home, even if the schedule is in an Eco period.
data_description.persons_force_comfort_start: Start time for the presence override.
data_description.persons_force_comfort_end: End time for the presence override.

data_description.proximity_entity: HA Proximity integration entity for geo‑fencing.
data_description.proximity_distance: Start pre-conditioning when person is within this radius (meters).
data_description.proximity_duration: Person must be within radius for this long before triggering.

data_description.presence_sensor: A binary sensor for room‑level occupancy detection.
data_description.scheduler_presence: Schedule that defines when presence detection is active.
data_description.presence_reaction_on: Wait this long after detecting presence before switching to Comfort.
data_description.presence_reaction_off: Wait this long after losing presence before switching to Eco.

expert_behavior.title: 5/6 · Behavior & Rules
expert_behavior.description: Fine‑tune how the system reacts to various conditions: season mode, temperature limits, away offset, and manual overrides.

data_description.season_mode_entity: Controls whether climate automation is active. ON = automation active, OFF = automation inactive.
data_description.idle_temperature: Fallback temperature when the automation is inactive.
data_description.room_temp_threshold_enabled: Enable an upper limit on room temperature.
data_description.room_temp_threshold: Stop the climate control when the room reaches this temperature.

data.min_instead_of_off: Use minimum temp instead of OFF

data_description.min_instead_of_off: Never fully turn off the TRV; use its minimum setting instead.
data_description.off_if_above_room_temp: Turn off devices when the target temperature in the room has already been reached.
data_description.enable_temporary_manual_override: When a user manually changes the TRV or UI, override the schedule until the next schedule block starts.

data_description.away_behavior: Select what the system should do when the house is empty.
data_description.away_offset: Temperature adjustment applied when the system is in away mode. Set to 0 to disable – away mode will then have no effect on temperature.
data_description.away_presence_mode: If enabled, local presence sensors still trigger comfort mode even during absence.
data_description.away_ignore_people: Do not use person tracking for away mode decisions.

data_description.aggressive_mode_selector: Boost performance when temperature is far from target.
data_description.aggressive_range: Temperature difference that activates aggressive mode.
data_description.aggressive_offset: Additional temperature offset during aggressive mode.

expert_advanced.title: 6/6 · Advanced & Protection
expert_advanced.description: Valve positioning, frost & liming protection, and system timing.

data_description.valve_mode: Directly control TRV valve position instead of temperature. "Off" leaves the valve untouched; the curve decides how fast it opens for a given temperature difference.
data_description.valve_step: Percentage step size for each valve adjustment.
data_description.valve_min: Opening at which your valve is still physically closed (e.g. 18). Every opening above 0 is spread over the range from this value up to the maximum opening, so even the smallest opening lets water through. Closed (0 %) stays closed. 0 = no minimum.
data_description.valve_keyword: Only control valves whose entity name contains this keyword.

data_description.frost_protection_enabled: Enable or disable automatic frost protection for this room.
data_description.frost_protection_temp: Minimum temperature to prevent pipes from freezing.
data_description.liming_protection: Enable or disable automatic anti‑liming cycle (valve exercise).
data_description.liming_day: Day of the week for the anti‑liming cycle.
data_description.liming_time: Time of day for the anti‑liming cycle (HH:MM:SS).
data_description.liming_duration: Duration of the anti‑liming cycle in minutes.
data_description.liming_in_season: Also run the anti‑liming cycle during season mode.

data_description.action_delay: Quiet time after the last change before Tempix recalculates (several changes are bundled), and pause between the mode and temperature command of one thermostat.
data_description.sensor_retention: Time after Tempix starts in which person states count as restart artifacts: the arrival and departure delays are skipped, and unavailable persons count as home.

data_description.schedulers: Select schedule helper entities for Comfort/Eco switching.
data_description.scheduler_selector: Optional entity that selects which schedule is active.
data_description.holiday_calendar: Optional: a calendar.holiday_* entity from the HA Holiday integration. If a holiday is detected today, the heating schedule for the selected day is used instead.
data_description.holiday_use_day: Which weekday schedule to use on public holidays.
data_description.vacation_home_use_day: Overrides Holiday Use Day while the “Vacation at home” switch is active. Falls back to Holiday Use Day if left empty.

error.no_trvs: Please select at least one thermostat (TRV).
error.trv_in_use: At least one of these thermostats is already controlled by another Tempix entry. A thermostat belongs to exactly one entry.
error.invalid_adjustments: The adjustments JSON is invalid. Expected a JSON list of objects, each with a "time" field (for example "08:00").

error.no_trvs: Please select at least one thermostat (TRV).
error.trv_in_use: At least one of these thermostats is already controlled by another Tempix entry. A thermostat belongs to exactly one entry.
error.invalid_adjustments: The adjustments JSON is invalid. Expected a JSON list of objects, each with a "time" field (for example "08:00").

override_disabled.message: The temporary manual override is disabled for {name}. Enable 'Enable Temporary Manual Override' in the options first.

room_paused.title: {name} is paused
room_paused.description: Automatic climate control for "{name}" has been paused since {since} because: {reason}. Check whether the affected sensor is still working (e.g. dead battery or lost connection) — the room will resume automatically once it recovers.

room_update_failing.title: {name}: automatic control is failing
room_update_failing.description: The update loop for "{name}" has been failing since {since} with: {error}. The room is not being controlled. Check the log for the full traceback and consider reloading the integration.

room_calibration_unavailable.title: {name}: calibration is inactive
room_calibration_unavailable.description: Generic calibration for "{name}" has not been working since {since}: {trvs} reports no internal temperature (current_temperature is empty). The room keeps heating/cooling, but with the uncalibrated setpoint. Typical causes: thermostat summer mode (e.g. FRITZ heating schedule) or a lost radio connection. The issue resolves itself once the thermostat reports a temperature again.

room_trv_unavailable.title: {name}: thermostat unreachable
room_trv_unavailable.description: The thermostat/AC for "{name}" has been unavailable since {since}: {trvs}. Tempix cannot control this device — it is skipped entirely, so it may be stuck in its last state (e.g. still heating). Check the device's power, battery and radio connection. The issue resolves itself once the device is reachable again.

room_trv_unavailable_paused.title: {name}: device unreachable in manual mode
room_trv_unavailable_paused.description: "{name}" is in manual mode, so Tempix deliberately sends no commands of its own. The thermostat/AC has been unavailable since {since}, though: {trvs}. Changes you make on the Tempix card are passed on but do not reach the device — the card still shows them. Check the device's power, battery and radio connection. If the device is off on purpose (e.g. for the season), ignore this issue; it stays hidden across restarts until the device has been back. The issue resolves itself once the device is reachable again.

room_degraded.title: {name}: running on a fallback value
room_degraded.description: "{name}" has been running on a degraded input since {since} instead of the real sensor value: {reason}. Depending on the cause, Tempix keeps controlling the room on this untrusted basis or holds the setpoints: if all room sensors are down, the thermostats keep their last setpoint (only valve position and frost protection continue). Check the affected sensor. The issue resolves itself once the input is valid again.

room_dead_reference.title: {name}: configured entity no longer exists
room_dead_reference.description: "{name}" refers to entities that do not exist in Home Assistant: {entities}. Detected since {since}. A deleted or renamed entity produces no error — it fails silently: presence detection, window detection or the schedule can stop working with nothing anywhere to show for it. Remove the reference in the room's settings, or restore the entity. The notice disappears once the reference is removed or the entity is restored; until then it stays.

config_temp_order.title: {name}: Comfort/Eco temperature order looks reversed
config_temp_order.description: "{name}" has comfort and eco in the same direction, but the temperatures contradict it: {details}. Heating: comfort should be at least eco; cooling: comfort should be at most eco. As configured, comfort heats/cools less than eco. Check the room's temperatures. This notice resolves itself once the settings are consistent.

config_mode_conflict.title: {name}: comfort and eco disagree on heating vs. cooling
config_mode_conflict.description: "{name}" has one phase on heat and the other on cool: {details}. Tempix then silently treats the whole room as cooling. Set both phases to the same direction. This notice resolves itself once the settings are consistent.

config_frost_above_eco.title: {name}: frost protection is above the eco temperature
config_frost_above_eco.description: Frost protection for "{name}" is set higher than the eco temperature: {details}. Frost protection then raises every eco target to the frost temperature, so eco never takes effect as configured. Lower the frost temperature or raise eco.

config_adjustments.title: {name}: schedule adjustments contain unusable entries
config_adjustments.description: The adjustments of "{name}" contain entries that will be ignored or never match: {details}. Entry numbers start at 0. Fields: time must be HH:MM (e.g. 06:30), mode one of comfort/eco/off/auto, days must contain Mon–Sun (capitalised, e.g. Mon, Sat). Fix the JSON in the room's settings.

config_holiday_no_day.title: {name}: holiday calendar without a replacement weekday
config_holiday_no_day.description: "{name}" uses the holiday calendar {details}, but no weekday is set to use on holidays. The holiday override never takes effect. Set the holiday weekday in the room's settings.

config_aggressive_no_offset.title: {name}: aggressive mode without an offset
config_aggressive_no_offset.description: "{name}" has aggressive mode enabled ({details}). The boost has no effect. Set an offset above 0 or turn aggressive mode off.

config_preconditioning_zero.title: {name}: smart pre-conditioning has no lead time
config_preconditioning_zero.description: "{name}" has smart pre-conditioning enabled, but the maximum lead time is 0 ({details}). It can never start early. Set a maximum lead time above 0 or turn it off.

config_proximity_zero.title: {name}: proximity distance is 0
config_proximity_zero.description: "{name}" uses a proximity sensor with {details}. The proximity “towards” trigger practically never fires (the “arrived” channel ignores the distance). Set a distance above 0.

config_valve_min_not_below_max.title: {name}: minimum valve opening is not below the maximum
config_valve_min_not_below_max.description: "{name}" has valve positioning enabled with {details}. The valve can then only be closed or fully at the maximum opening, nothing in between. Set the minimum opening below the maximum opening.
